notes.title: Pip's café: drinks
notes.text:
Mango Cloud is a cold drink made with mango, oat milk, and ice. Mango Cloud costs 4 café coins.

Mango Spark is a fizzy drink made with mango and sparkling water. Mango Spark costs 3 café coins.

Mint Moon is a warm drink made with mint and water. Mint Moon costs 2 café coins and contains no mango.

notes.title: Opening the little café
notes.text:
On weekdays, Pip's café opens at 09:00 and closes at 17:00.

On Saturday, Pip's café opens at 10:00 and closes at 14:00. The café is closed on Sunday.

notes.title: The puzzle club
notes.text:
Puzzle club meets at Pip's café on Saturday at 11:00. Guests bring one paper puzzle to swap.

Puzzle club has six seats. Book a seat at the counter before Saturday; no online booking is offered.

notes.title: Borrow a board game
notes.text:
Board games are for use inside Pip's café. Guests return each board game to the shelf before leaving.

The board game shelf has Chess, Word Trail, and Tiny Towers. The café notes do not describe how to play these games.
